publisher: Jonathan S. Walters and Whitman College
specific_over_generic: site.json generic CC BY4.0 is not used to relax the express textual CC BY-NC-SA4.0 grant.
required: Preserve translator/publisher attribution, work title, immutable revision/source path, licence URL and complete applicable notice.
Noncommercial use; adaptations shared under compatible BY-NC-SA terms, with changes/extraction disclosed and no implied endorsement.
Bodies, original notes, prefaces and summaries remain live-only; package only metadata and integrity hashes.
Scope approval covers textual notes and apparatus only; no audio, images, media, third-party trademark/font or new hosting approval.

five_source_tests.standing: Named scholar translation published by Walters/Whitman; imperfect work-in-progress disclaimer retained.
five_source_tests.permission: Specific about License section, complete LICENSE.md, footer and epub rights concordantly permit attributable noncommercial adaptation/share-alike.
five_source_tests.respect: Pinned notices contain no request prohibiting this use; no prohibited source ingested. This is a bounded pinned-artifact review, not a claim to survey every future publisher statement.
five_source_tests.durability: Official apadana-translation/apadana-site immutable commit and content-addressed Git artifacts.
five_source_tests.verifiability: Exact per-poem file/order, printed local/global labels, both colophons, owned notes and raw scope hashes.

changes_notice: Presentation extraction only: remove the reviewed Markdown heading/emphasis markers and abbreviation tags; unescape literal bracket and cross-reference punctuation; replace footnote references with explicit note labels; remove Markdown hard-break padding while preserving every line and paragraph. Preserve publisher wording, typography, diacritics, brackets, uncertainties, both numbering systems and both colophons. Keep translator notes and the note-free publisher preface/chapter summary separately owned. No translation wording is generated, corrected or harmonized to VRI. Complete publisher-edition poems are not line-complete VRI translations.
edition_statement: Follows PTS with explicit BJTS corrections/alternatives and translator interpretations. Do not claim this equals every VRI line.
